For one, pharma companies and hospitals should be required to make all pricing transparent.

It’s absurd we pay so much more than other countries - we need to get to the root of that.

@ImSoVirtual four people are making it easier for trump to win:
cornel west, jill stein, joe manchin (if he runs),
and joe biden

the only reason i’m losing sleep is from disbelief that people aren’t seeing we’re walking back into 2016 - but worse.

Sorry I missed your question.

1. I’ll defeat Trump.
2. Laser focused economic policy on affordability.
3. All hands on deck housing production initiative to eliminate homelessness in America.
4. Codify women’s reproductive freedom into law.
5. Pass national health insurance legislation to include mental/emotional health coverage so that no American incurs medical debt or goes bankrupt any longer.
6. Legalize cannabis and reschedule psilocybin.
7. Change asylum laws to keep migrants safe and reduce chaos at our southern border.
8. Lead with courage and the daily intention to repair and bring peace to America and the world.

.@ianbremmer nails it. To fix it:

Nat’l health insurance for all, convert fee for service to capitation, & preclude the sale of any pharmaceutical at a price higher than those offered to Canada, Japan, France, the UK, etc.

We’ll spend less by moving from sick care to health care.

Medicare For All is a centrist, common sense solution to our unaffordable sick care disaster.

With 26mm uninsured, 90mm underinsured, the highest prices in the world, and mid-pack outcomes - we should be embarrassed.

We ensure public education for all and must ensure health coverage for all. Period.

@joshtpm Sure. Have always advocated for a public option, am a 2x co-sponsor of the State Based Universal Health Care Act, and was working w/Rep. Jayapal and her team to join M4A for almost a year - in spite of America’s largest health insurer being based in my district.

By next Christmas we’ll be preparing to expand healthcare coverage to all, forbid medicines from being sold at higher prices than peer nations, build enough homes to end homelessness and lower rents, and cease burdening students with trillions in debt to become educated. Ready?

New Year’s Wishes:

Peace among Americans and nations of the world, and an end to war and bloodshed.

Good health to President Biden as he navigates crises at home and abroad.

More repair, reconnection, and reinvigoration, and less hate, anger, and antagonism.

Another installment of 15 With Dean w/@Jason.

This time we discuss the American sickcare "system", for which we pay 2x more than any other nation, 3-5x more for prescription drugs, and generates only mid-pack health outcomes.

It's time for universal national health insurance and real competition among health systems to keep us healthy - not just treat us when we get sick. (If we're so lucky.)

A roof over one’s head is the foundation under one’s feet. No longer will Americans sleep outside and life be so unaffordable after I’m President.

We’re going to build 7 million homes and design entirely new 21st century communities for healthy living.

https://t.co/H5qUeuTjdP

Chronic homelessness has doubled since 2016.

It’s inexcusable, inhumane, and a solvable problem requiring bold leadership.

Produce housing, reduce red tape & zoning hurdles, mental + physical health coverage for all, treatment + recovery programming, & targeted guaranteed income.

Applying health insurers profits to human care and negotiating pharma prices in line with peer countries would provide ~$300 billion to cover every uninsured American.

That’s why it’s time for national health insurance / Medicare for All.

In 1994, middle class Americans held 2x more wealth than the top 1%.

In 2024, middle class Americans hold LESS wealth than the top 1%, and it’s getting worse.

It’s time for new leadership, American Dream Accounts, debt-free, PreK-college education, National Health Insurance, and 7m new homes.

We can do it. And we must.

Under my National Health Insurance plan, we will finally establish a mental & emotional
health care system and an addiction treatment and recovery system - accessible to ALL Americans.

Such investments will reduce diseases of despair and suicides, and we’ll use data to drive decisions.
@georgevhulme Yes, George. And the self-employed will have national health insurance coverage, too.

Kudos to the Biden Administration for strong macro economic growth.

I’ll focus on ensuring more of that growth accrues to the 60% of Americans living paycheck to paycheck and 40% with < $400 in the bank.

➡️American Dream Accounts, Nat’l Health Insurance, Debt Free Education, UBI pilots, and 7 million new homes. 🇺🇸

As President, I will appoint the most experienced, competent managers in America who will ensure we implement controls to prevent $2 billion fraud schemes.

It’s inconceivable we don’t already do so. https://t.co/FeYOp0SF8Y

We’ve had many years to anticipate the blessings and curses of AI - on our economy, in medicine, and in society - and Europe has already passed its AI Act.

As President, I’ll lead the AI Century by enabling innovation, preparing our workforce and economy, pursuing cost savings, and ensuring robust guardrails are in place to protect our kids, our elections, and our security.

Too many of our neighbors are struggling with lives that have become unaffordable, from families with young children, to retirees, to homeless men and women I’ve come to know.

Housing, healthcare, education, and groceries are simply too expensive and inaccessible for many millions of hardworking people, and chaos at our border, in our cities, and around the world is making people afraid - and angry that no one seems to be listening.

The people I’ve met, the stories I’ve heard, and the possibilities I’ve discovered have led to my policy platform which I’ll be rolling out over the coming weeks. 

11/14

Can we stop focusing on which elderly candidate makes more gaffes and start focusing on the crisis at our border, the economic & social disruption of AI, ending bloody wars, and reducing housing, healthcare, and education costs for hard-working American families?

We owe it to the future to reduce gun violence now.

At the very least we can agree on red flag laws, suicide reduction investments, and an all hands on deck initiative to embed mental and emotional healthcare into American schools and society.

Devastating news. My heart is with the officers’ families and the @BurnsvillePD.

Too many firearms in the hands of people in need of emotional healthcare, not guns.

It's time to invest in peace, it's time to invest in children, and it's time to invest in America.

1.  American Dream Accounts: $20k at HS graduation
2. End homelessness and build 7m homes
3. Physical & Emotional Healthcare coverage for all 
4. Debt-free education PreK-college 
5. Fix Social Security
6. Secure our borders & streamline immigration
7.  Term limits for Congress & SCOTUS
8. Conserve America's financial and natural resources

A new generation is ready to get to work. Together.

It’s inexcusable that medical debt is the leading cause of bankruptcy in America.

The case for National Health Insurance is clear: reduce costs, increase wellness, and rectify injustice.

Achieving healthcare for all must become a priority of our generation.

Hello, Michiganders! 👋 A vote for me tomorrow is a vote for peace and for a bright future.

It’s a vote for investing in the health, education, and opportunity for our children, and protecting reproductive rights & LGBTQ+ Americans.

And a vote to defeat Donald Trump. 
https://t.co/zCit2vOdvF
